_readme: Clinic gallery. To add a photo: put the file (JPG, PNG or WebP, at least 800px wide) in assets/img/gallery/, set its path as 'src' below, then run: node src/optimize-gallery.mjs && node src/build.mjs. 'focus' sets which part stays visible when the photo is cropped to 4:3 (CSS object-position, e.g. 'center', 'top', 'left 30%'). Leave 'src' as null to show a placeholder tile. The first 5 photos show by default; the rest appear with 'View more photos'.
